## ObsidiAI 0.1.8

### Fix chat text selection

- Enable text selection in user messages, assistant responses (including code blocks), and expanded tool results so selected text can be copied with Ctrl/Cmd+C.
- Keep buttons and other controls unchanged.

### Install or update

1. Download **[obsidiai-0.1.8.zip](https://github.com/KNN-07/ObsidiAI/releases/download/0.1.8/obsidiai-0.1.8.zip)**, not GitHub's automatic source archive.
2. Replace `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css` in `<vault>/.obsidian/plugins/obsidiai/`. Preserve `data.json` and `history.json` if present.
3. Reload Obsidian or disable/re-enable ObsidiAI after the current run settles.

Requirements remain **Obsidian desktop 1.11.4+** and **embedded Node 22.19.0+**. The three individual plugin files are also attached.

### Verification

- Production build, all **163 tests**, and release metadata/assets validation passed.
- Chromium smoke verification with the actual stylesheet and representative chat markup reproduced blocked selection under a non-selectable parent before the fix. After the fix, mouse selection worked for user text, assistant text, code blocks, and tool results; Ctrl+C dispatched a copy event with the selected tool text. Buttons remained non-selectable.
- This patch was not verified inside a running native Obsidian host or against the operating-system clipboard.
